style_line: Style: 1990s Japanese OVA hand-painted cel look: thick brush-like black ink outlines, airbrushed cel highlights on the shell and hat, rich deep colors, strong rim lighting, a little gritty and cinematic. No text, no letters, no logos. PNG with a fully transparent background (alpha channel), square 1024x1024, subject fills about 80% of the canvas, full body, centered, standing upright.

master.name: カメロック
master.design: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a plump gourmet: round chubby body, an orange trench coat over a brown tweed vest with a gold watch chain, a white bib napkin tucked into the collar, a brown tweed deerstalker hat, rosy cheeks. In one flipper he holds a white ceramic bowl of CLEAR GOLDEN BROTH SOUP: thin transparent consommé-like liquid with a few small green herb leaves floating and gentle steam rising, with a silver spoon (it must clearly read as a light clear soup; absolutely no rice, no cutlet, no egg, no noodles). In the other flipper a golden magnifying glass.

poses.master_base: Facing slightly to the right, eyes open with a calm confident half-smile, the magnifying glass raised as if inviting a question.
poses.master_happy: Facing slightly to the right, wide delighted grin with eyes closed happily, cheeks flushed, lifting the soup bowl a little higher as if celebrating a great question.

jr.name: カメロック Jr.
jr.design: The small child of the gourmet turtle detective: a cute chubby baby sea turtle with a round belly, wearing an oversized brown tweed deerstalker hat that slips down over one eye, a small green bow tie, and a tiny white bib napkin like his father's, holding a small spiral notebook and a yellow pencil, big curious sparkling eyes, mouth open as if asking a question.

poses.jr_base: Head and body clearly turned toward the LEFT side of the image, looking UP and to the LEFT at his father who stands off-frame to the left; both eyes and pupils clearly directed to the left, chin slightly raised. The flipper nearer the viewer is raised with one finger up as if asking a question, the small spiral notebook held in the other flipper.

background_prompt: A stylized 1990s Japanese OVA anime background painting (hand-painted cel-era background art, poster-color textures, clean shapes): the interior of a seaside restaurant at night seen from inside. A lone man sits at a small table with a white tablecloth by a large arched window; on the table a single white bowl of soup steams, lit warmly by a candle. Through the window, a clearly visible moonlit sea with waves and a bright full moon. Mid-key lighting, NOT dark: warm amber light on the table and walls, cool blue moonlight outside, strong readable shapes and high contrast, colors stay readable even when darkened by 30 percent. No text, no letters, no logos. Do not depict any clue to the story's truth (no ships, no wreck, no other people except at most one waiter silhouette far in the background). Vertical 9:16 composition, output 1024x1536 portrait, keep the upper 55 percent relatively calm (sky, wall, window) so text can be overlaid.

narration_gemini.voice_description: 30歳くらいの日本人男性の探偵。お相撲さんのように太っていて食いしん坊。太っているのが声からも伝わる、丸みがあって太く柔らかい声で、少年っぽさの残る人懐っこさがある。可愛らしいが、謎を語るときは得意げ。子供に語り掛ける優しいパパのような話し方。
narration_gemini.style: 子供に語り掛ける優しいパパの口調で、とっておきの謎を得意げに語り、続けて同じ口調のまま親しげに呼びかける。間は短く、早口ぎみの速いテンポで。
